name: premiere-night
vibe: A cinema premiere — a deep dark house, two spotlights sweeping the room, marquee bulb rails chasing along the top and bottom, a film strip drifting up the edge, projector grain and a heavy vignette. High-contrast serif titling, thin bright device edges, a slow dolly on every scene, and theatre cuts that rotate through doors, iris and blinds so the same door never opens twice. Brand colour relights the house — spotlights, bulbs, glow and edges. Portrait-native 9:16. Best for premium launches, film, entertainment and award-night brands.
